elements.requirement: A company qualifies as small in relation to its first financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.
elements.quote: A company qualifies as small in relation to its first financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.

elements.requirement: A company qualifies as small in relation to a subsequent financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year and the preceding financial year.
elements.quote: if the qualifying conditions are met in that year and the preceding financial year

elements.requirement: A company qualifies as small in relation to a subsequent financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year and the company qualified as small in relation to the preceding financial year.
elements.quote: if the qualifying conditions are met in that year and the company qualified as small in relation to the preceding financial year

elements.requirement: A company qualifies as small in relation to a subsequent financial year if the qualifying conditions were met in the preceding financial year and the company qualified as small in relation to that year.
elements.quote: if the qualifying conditions were met in the preceding financial year and the company qualified as small in relation to that year

elements.requirement: The qualifying conditions are met by a company in a year in which it satisfies two or more of the specified requirements regarding turnover, balance sheet total, and number of employees.
elements.quote: The qualifying conditions are met by a company in a year in which it satisfies two or more of the following requirements

elements.requirement: The maximum figures for turnover must be proportionately adjusted for a period that is a company's financial year but not in fact a year.
elements.quote: For a period that is a company's financial year but not in fact a year the maximum figures for turnover must be proportionately adjusted.

elements.requirement: The balance sheet total of a company means the aggregate of the amounts shown as assets in the company's balance sheet.
elements.quote: The balance sheet total means the aggregate of the amounts shown as assets in the company's balance sheet.

elements.requirement: A company's number of employees means the average number of persons employed by the company in the year, determined by finding for each month in the financial year the number of persons employed under contracts of service by the company in that month (whether throughout the month or not), adding together the monthly totals, and dividing by the number of months in the financial year.
elements.quote: The number of employees means the average number of persons employed by the company in the year, determined as follows— (a) find for each month in the financial year the number of persons employed under contracts of service by the company in that month (whether throughout the month or not), (b) add together the monthly totals, and (c) divide by the number of months in the financial year.

elements.requirement: Section 382 is subject to section 383 regarding parent companies qualifying as small.
elements.quote: This section is subject to section 383 (companies qualifying as small: parent companies).

thresholds.what: minimum number of requirements a company must satisfy to meet the qualifying conditions
thresholds.quote: satisfies two or more of the following requirements
Balance sheet total Not more than £3.26 million
Number of employees Not more than 50
